purpose: The round marker of a Stepper step: its number or icon while active or locked, a check when completed and a warning on error. Not for standalone use.

notFor.case: Used on its own, outside a StepperIndicator.
A decorative icon in a tinted circle.

Status=active.visual: Fill Action/primary/default, number or icon in Content/on-action.

Status=completed.visual: Fill Surface/accent, an automatic check in Content/accent.

Status=error.visual: Fill Status/critical/surface-solid, an automatic warning in Status/critical/on-solid.

Disabled.visual: Fill Action/disabled/default, glyph Content/disabled for every Status.

notes: Completed and error markers carry a screen-reader-only "Completed" / "Error".

openQuestions: Motion: the State axis has no motion decision and recipes/motion.ts has no entry (finding MOT-002). Should the marker change animate?
A locked step shows its number on Surface/muted, not a lock icon. Is that intended?
